utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Wednesday the fourteenth of October. Have we got everyone on?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, I'm here. Bit of an echo, but I can hear you.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Probably this room. Anyway, the broken coffee machine in the canteen has made me extremely popular this morning.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: It's dispensing disappointment again, is it?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exclusively. And the heating in the portakabin seems to have two settings: off and tropical. Just having a moan, neither is going on this list.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Tropical sounds quite nice from where I'm sitting.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before we get distracted completely—finished bits first.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, so I signed off the inspection on the 11kV Switchboard on Tuesday. That's complete.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely, closed, not rolling that forward.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And I already swapped the filter on the chiller on three yesterday. That one's done as well.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Same sort of update from me: already swapped the filter on the Water Booster Pump yesterday. Finished, not another job for today.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Good. Nice to hear the word finished occasionally.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Um, just an observation from me. I saw the pressure on the outfeed conveyor dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Came back without anyone touching anything?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, on its own. Not raising a job off it, just saying what I saw.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. I heard a slight rattle from the BFP, nothing to action yet. Same thing, observation only.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Understood. Not treating that as a new maintenance request.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: On the blocked stuff, still waiting on parts for the waste heat boiler, nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, still blocked. Nothing new being handed out on that.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And I can't get to the main water valve until production gives us a window.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, there isn't a window available. That's why it's still sat there.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, existing blocker, not a fresh action. Let's get onto what we can actually agree.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Hannah Price, can you do the pre-use checks on the trucks? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll do the pre-use checks on the trucks.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks. Important, just not an urgent one in the list.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Understood. And pre-use still means before they're used, obviously.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: While I'm on, I'll check the guarding on the pick and place on two tomorrow at 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Hannah. Tomorrow at 9:30 for that guarding check.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep, that's the time I've got. I'll do it then.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I'll sort the training records for the new starters next week as well.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Sorry, you clipped slightly—next week for the records?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Next week, yeah. I'll sort them. Not saying they're already done.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Got you, Callum. Training records with you, next week.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: There's also spare parts for the IM3. We need to order those. That still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Has that actually got an owner, or is it just sitting on the list?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: No owner. I'm raising it, not volunteering to take it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, ordering spare parts for the IM3 stays unallocated. Nobody's taken that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Callum, can you investigate the pressure drop on the IM1 hydraulic unit by Monday? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I can't take that one, sorry. I haven't got the capacity to give it a proper look.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fair enough. Fi, can I hand that to you instead—the pressure drop on the IM1 hydraulic unit, by Monday, normal priority?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll investigate the pressure drop on the IM1 hydraulic unit by Monday. Normal priority, understood.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Just to be clear, that's an investigation, not a promise it'll be repaired by Monday?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Exactly. I'll investigate it. We're not agreeing a repair off the back of a guess.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct. Investigation with Fi, not Callum.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: There's the purchase order for the turbine one gas valve as well. That needs chasing.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes. Hannah Price, can you chase the purchase order for the turbine one gas valve by next Tuesday? No rush.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep, I'll chase the purchase order for the turbine one gas valve by next Tuesday. No rush, got it.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Cheers. It's the purchase order we're talking about, not doing anything to the valve.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And Han, can you update the risk assessment for work on the fire panel today? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll update the risk assessment for work on the fire panel today.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you—just the assessment, we're not agreeing work on the panel itself here?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Just the risk assessment, yeah. No physical work being added.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's right. It matters but it's not urgent; today is still the deadline.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Quite a few different dates in there. Easy to hear all that as 'everything today'.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, no. Risk assessment today; the other dates are as we've just agreed.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And my investigation is Monday, normal priority. I've got that straight.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, exactly.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And the IM3 order is still nobody's? Just checking it hasn't acquired my name because I mentioned it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Still nobody's. Raised as needing doing, but not allocated.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Fine. Main water valve stays blocked too, then. No access window, no change.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Same with the waste heat boiler. Still waiting on the parts; nothing moving there.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Those stay as blockers, and the completed bits stay closed. No extra actions hidden in the updates.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Good. It's absolutely tipping it down outside, by the way. Lovely morning for a factory.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: At least we've got the tropical portakabin experience.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Luxury, isn't it? Right, thanks everyone. That's us.
